summary.purpose: Exposes HTTP endpoints for retrieving a fixed shipping rate and creating shipments via an external HTTP provider, defaulting to the CommerceLens mock provider.
flow: Receive shipment creation request with orderId, postalCode, and scenario
Validate input constraints before invoking provider
Send POST /shipments to provider with Idempotency-Key header equal to orderId
Validate provider response structure and fixed shippingCents value
Return shipment details or map failures to HTTP 502/504/422 with outcome status
unknowns: A logical external shipping-provider boundary is documented; the default is a local mock. A production provider deployment is not established by these pages.

review: Codex reviewed against selected service wiki pages; removed unsupported ambiguity claims and distinguished provider boundaries from mock deployments.
